authorization: User requested continued theoretical investigation of widths, seeds, functions, derived parameters, substring matching and second-order transforms.
scope: Primary-source review, independent mathematical review and small exact calculations. No corpus access, CIX codec experiment or production change.
calculations: Kraft counting upper bound for savings of 8, 16, 32 and 64 bits on a uniformly distributed fixed-length input, under a fixed complete prefix code without uncharged side information.

State/phase equivalence and XOR closure for 4-bit linear recurrences with feedback bit indexes 1 and 3, output bit 0, right shift, and feedback inserted at bit 3. Examine all 16 states and phases 0 through 14 using 64 output bits.
Compare 256 same-recurrence seed pairs with 256 different-recurrence seed pairs by distinct generated outputs; this is an algebraic witness, not a PRNG quality or compression test.

Idealized independent two-list XOR matching at target width 128 and per-list seed widths 32 and 64: candidate count, expected match count, union bound and vector storage lower accounting. No lists will be materialized.
interpretation: Distinguish effective output diversity, complete description length and search cost. No ideal bit calculation is a physical archive saving.
release_gate: Unchanged; all existing source/quality requirements and benchmark stop remain in force.
